basis: Two new public-primary-source pilots after a methodology revision. Sources are not attached/private-project seed material.

records.authors: Markus Grassl; Zhengfeng Ji; Zhaohui Wei; Bei Zeng
records.title: Quantum-capacity-approaching codes for the detected-jump channel
records.read_depth: Primary parsed Eqs.(1)-(8),(16), perfect detected-jump construction, and explicit final distinction from unrestricted environment assistance. No graphical capacity values imported.
records.use: Inherited detected-jump model, degradability method and perfect-detection comparison. Partial physical collection and arbitrary collective helper measurement need a distinct implication.
records.limit: No claim to have exhausted imperfect-collection or flagged-amplitude-damping literature.

records.authors: Toby S. Cubitt; Mary-Beth Ruskai; Graeme Smith
records.title: The structure of degradable quantum channels
records.read_depth: Primary introduction, channel/complement definitions, additivity and concavity attribution, antidegradability/no-cloning zero-capacity paragraph.
records.use: Standard capacity consequences, not a newly discovered information-theoretic principle.
records.limit: The complete classifications and appendices were not audited.

records.authors: John A. Smolin; Frank Verstraete; Andreas Winter
records.title: Entanglement of assistance and multipartite state distillation
records.read_depth: Primary environment-assistance result and metadata identified. The exact operational capacity convention is cross-checked in A4.
records.use: Attribution for known whole-environment collective assistance.
records.limit: Not an independent reproduction of the entire assistance proof or a theorem for access to only D.

records.title: Potential capacities of quantum channels
records.read_depth: Primary SectionII, Eqs.(5)-(9), and the full environment-to-receiver classical feedforward convention; author v5 metadata checked.
records.use: Exact full-environment comparator and distinction between capacities.
records.limit: The paper's potential-capacity classifications are not claimed audited.

records.authors: Bingzhi Zhang; Fangjun Hu; Runzhe Mo; Tianyang Chen; Hakan E. Tureci; Quntao Zhuang
records.title: Scaling Laws of Quantum Information Lifetime in Monitored Quantum Dynamics
records.read_depth: Primary abstract and publication metadata, and publisher model/scope passages on monitored many-body dynamics and partial-monitoring QMI transitions.
records.use: Ensures that generic partial monitoring and information-lifetime transitions are not claimed new.
records.limit: No reconstruction of their chaotic-system or experimental data; this does not certify lack of overlap with every source extension.

records.authors: Tommaso Roscilde; Filippo Caleca; Adriano Angelone; Fabio Mezzacapo
records.title: Scalable spin squeezing from critical slowing down in short-range interacting systems
records.read_depth: Primary available v1 main model, U(1) symmetry, square geometry, critical magnetization, rotor squeezing/time scaling and rotor-spin-wave validity discussion.
records.use: The independent question is geometric scaling in one critical strip, not invention of scalable short-range squeezing.
records.limit: No source numerical plot/table values imported; no microscopic spectrum coefficient is silently equated to our declared continuum G. No full source many-body simulation reproduced.

records.title: Universal Spin Squeezing Dynamical Phase Transitions across Lattice Geometries, Dimensions, and Microscopic Couplings
records.read_depth: Primary SectionsII-IV, bilayer Hamiltonian, interlayer/intralayer coupling ratio, separation-to-extent aspect ratio, and quadratic/nonlinear comparison; author metadata verified.
records.use: Prevents a generic new-geometry claim. The source's bilayer geometry is distinguished from the single-strip critical question.
records.limit: No quoted fit values or figure-data audit; not an exhaustive nonlinear stability-theorem comparison.

records.title: Light cone dynamics and reverse Kibble-Zurek mechanism in two-dimensional superfluids following a quantum quench
records.use: Established Gaussian phase/light-cone framework and importance of later vortex physics.
records.limit: No assertion that this source derives the exact finite-width formula in the note.

reading_and_access_limits: Primary PDFs were read through parsed mathematical text; no unread figure or table value is used as numerical evidence.
An unavailable HTML version of the 2024 squeezing paper was not treated as a read newer version; available primary PDF v1 is the cited reading.
A requested HTML v3 route for the monitored-dynamics article failed; its accessible primary publisher/author records supplied the explicitly reported scope.
A stray incomplete arXiv identifier was requested during metadata checks and failed; it is not a source.
Search hits involving unrelated partial degradability, passive environmental input engineering, or secondary mirrors were not used to establish our theorem or its novelty.

The partial-detection searches did not establish a complete absence of predecessors. The most direct next check concerns imperfect detected jumps and collective measurements with inaccessible environment.
